title.label: Decent Notification System, But Lacks Flexibility

content.label:
WhatsApp’s notification settings are functional but limited. The ability to mute chats is useful, but the options are too restrictive. Right now, users can only choose between 8 hours, 1 week, or always, which isn’t flexible enough.

What’s Good?

✅ Simple and easy to use
✅ Custom alert tones for different contacts
✅ Clear interface

What Needs Improvement?

🔹 Custom mute durations – Instead of just 8 hours or a week, users should be able to set specific times (e.g., mute until 11:30 PM).
🔹 More time options – Allow shorter or longer durations, like 1 hour, 3 hours, or even 30 minutes.
🔹 Scheduled mute feature – Let users automatically mute notifications during specific hours (e.g., every night from 10 PM to 7 AM).

Final Verdict

WhatsApp’s notification settings do the job, but they lack flexibility. A custom mute timer would make it much more useful. Until then, it’s a decent but frustrating feature.
